title: SER-SL Functional Analyst
jobDescription: SER-SL Functional Analyst - Oracle Americas At Johnson Controls, we help customers create smarter, healthier, and more sustainable buildings through technology, service, and operational excellence. In this role, you will support Oracle Fusion processes that help service teams deliver reliable outcomes and respond effectively to business needs across the Americas. Role Overview We are looking for a Functional Analyst with 4-6 years of experience to support Oracle Fusion Service Logistics initiatives. You will work closely with business users, functional teams, and technical partners to analyze requirements, improve service processes, support testing and issue resolution, and help ensure stable operations after deployment. Key Responsibilities Gather and analyze business requirements for Oracle Fusion Service Logistics and related service processes. Translate functional needs into clear process designs, solution recommendations, and support documentation. Support system configuration validation, functional testing, user acceptance testing, and defect triage. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to resolve issues and improve end-to-end process flow. Monitor post-go-live performance and help stabilize solutions through issue analysis and corrective actions. Document functional requirements, process flows, test scenarios, and knowledge-transfer materials. Support ongoing improvements that strengthen service delivery, reliability, and user experience. How You Will Do It Stay close to the work by understanding the real service logistics process end to end and removing obstacles for users. Own outcomes with accountability by following issues through to closure, protecting data integrity, and escalating risks early. Improve every day through root-cause analysis, candid problem-solving, and practical process enhancements. Win as one team by collaborating with functional, technical, and business partners and respecting diverse perspectives. Use disciplined documentation, structured testing, and clear communication to support stable releases and smooth handovers. Apply Agile and DevOps-oriented ways of working where they are used, keeping work visible, coordinated, and focused on quality. Qualifications 4-6 years of experience in Oracle Fusion functional analysis, business analysis, or a similar enterprise applications role. Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Service Logistics or closely related Oracle Cloud service processes. Strong understanding of requirement gathering, process mapping, solution analysis, and functional support. Experience supporting testing, user acceptance testing, defect management, and post-implementation stabilization. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical solutions. Ability to prepare clear functional documentation, process flows, and support materials. Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to Have Exposure to Oracle Fusion Subscription Management Cloud (SMC), Maintenance Cloud (MC), or B2B Service. Familiarity with Agile delivery methods and DevOps-oriented support practices. Experience contributing to process improvement or continuous improvement initiatives. Why Join Us Join a collaborative environment where your ideas can help improve service operations and customer outcomes. You will have the opportunity to work on meaningful Oracle Fusion solutions in a team that values reliability, learning, and continuous improvement. If you are ready to bring your Oracle Fusion expertise to a role with real business impact, we invite you to apply.

title: RTR Functional Analyst
jobDescription: RTR Functional Analyst At Johnson Controls, we help customers create smarter, healthier, and more sustainable buildings. Our teams work across finance, operations, and technology to support business performance and deliver outcomes that matter. In this role, you will help strengthen Record to Report processes and support key finance activities in a collaborative environment where accuracy, service, and continuous improvement are valued. Role Overview We are looking for an RTR Functional Analyst with 4-6 years of experience to support Oracle Fusion Financials processes, month-end close activities, and finance transformation initiatives. You will work closely with RTR leads and cross-functional stakeholders to improve process performance, support issue resolution, and help ensure reliable financial operations. Key Responsibilities Support the development, enhancement, and day-to-day operation of RTR processes and solutions in Oracle Fusion Financials. Work with finance and project teams to analyze current and future-state R2R processes and identify improvement opportunities. Assist with month-end close activities, including process coordination, issue follow-up, and reporting support. Collaborate with stakeholders to support general ledger, fixed assets, intercompany, and tax-related process requirements. Participate in UAT by preparing scenarios, executing tests, documenting results, and tracking defects through resolution. Gather business inputs, document process requirements, and help translate them into practical system and process solutions. Prepare reports, validate data, and support decision-making with clear analysis and accurate documentation. Partner with finance, IT, and other functional teams to resolve issues and support successful delivery of enhancements and projects. How You Will Do It You will own your deliverables with accuracy, accountability, and integrity, especially during month-end and issue resolution. You will stay close to the process, understand upstream and downstream impacts, and remove blockers quickly for finance users and project teams. You will use clear analysis, candor, and continuous improvement to simplify RTR activities, close gaps, and strengthen controls. You will work as one team with finance, IT, and cross-functional partners, sharing knowledge and balancing different perspectives to reach the best outcome. You will use Oracle Fusion Financials and Excel to validate data, analyze results, and support accurate reporting. You will keep documentation current and communicate progress clearly so stakeholders understand risks, dependencies, and next steps. You will bring a structured, proactive approach to testing, issue follow-up, and process coordination. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. 4-6 years of experience in RTR, record-to-report, finance operations, or ERP project environments. Good understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials modules, including GL, FA, Intercompany, and Tax. Familiarity with R2R business processes and month-end close processes. Strong Excel skills, including working with data, formulas, and reconciliations. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. Nice to Have Experience supporting ERP implementation activities or finance transformation programs. Exposure to UAT, change management, or end-user training support. Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA, HFM, or OneStream. Why Join Us Join a team that values collaboration, practical problem-solving, and process excellence. At Johnson Controls, you will have the opportunity to support meaningful finance operations while contributing to an organization focused on delivering smarter and more sustainable outcomes. If you are ready to bring your RTR expertise to a dynamic finance environment, we invite you to apply today.

title: OTC Functional Analyst
jobDescription: OTC Functional Analyst At Johnson Controls, you will help support the systems and processes that enable customers to move from order to cash with accuracy, speed, and confidence. You will work with cross-functional teams to improve business performance, strengthen operational reliability, and support the day-to-day flow of Oracle Fusion OTC processes. Role Overview As an OTC Functional Analyst, you will support and improve Order-to-Cash processes across areas such as order management, invoicing, receipts, customer master data, and month-end activities. This role is well suited for a professional with 4-6 years of experience who enjoys solving business problems, working closely with stakeholders, and turning functional requirements into effective system support and process improvements. Key Responsibilities Support Oracle Fusion Order-to-Cash processes and contribute to stable, efficient business operations. Analyze functional requirements and help translate them into practical system solutions and process enhancements. Work with business and technical teams to support order management, invoicing, customer receipts, and related OTC activities. Assist with issue resolution, root cause analysis, and post-go-live support for business-critical processes. Support month-end close activities for OTC-related subledger processes, including reconciliation and documentation support. Partner with stakeholders to improve process reliability, data quality, and end-user experience. Contribute to testing, validation, and change support for system updates and process changes. Document functional flows, business rules, and support activities clearly and consistently. How You Will Do It You will stay close to the business process, listen carefully to user needs, and remove friction where it affects customers or operations. You will own your work with accountability, accuracy, safety-minded thinking, and integrity in every step. You will use a continuous-improvement mindset, asking questions, challenging gaps, and helping the team solve problems early. You will collaborate openly across business and technology teams, building trust and aligning different perspectives toward one outcome. You will support structured issue handling, clear documentation, and disciplined follow-through from analysis through resolution. You will contribute to reliable delivery by working methodically through testing, validation, and operational support activities. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. 4-6 years of experience in an OTC functional analyst, business analyst, or similar role. Strong understanding of Order-to-Cash processes and their impact across the business. Experience supporting Oracle Fusion OTC processes, including order management, invoicing, receipts, or related finance activities. Ability to analyze business requirements, identify process gaps, and support functional solutions. Experience working with customer master data and month-end close activities. Strong communication skills with the ability to work across business and technical teams. Solid problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to documentation and follow-up. Nice to Have Hands-on exposure to Oracle Fusion Financials AR or Oracle Fusion Order Management. Experience with invoice processing, receipt handling, or AR subledger support. Familiarity with DevOps or Agile ways of working. Experience supporting testing cycles, change requests, or post-go-live operational support. Why Join Us You will be part of a team that values practical problem-solving, customer impact, and continuous improvement. At Johnson Controls, your ideas and collaboration can help strengthen the processes that keep business moving and customers supported. If you are ready to bring your OTC expertise to a role where your work can make a real difference, we encourage you to apply.

title: Oracle Fusion Provisioning Analyst
jobDescription: Oracle Fusion Provisioning Analyst Johnson Controls delivers smart, healthy, and sustainable building solutions that help customers protect people, improve operations, and drive better outcomes. In this role, you will support secure Oracle Fusion access and control processes that help keep business operations reliable. You will work with cross-functional teams to manage provisioning, role configuration, compliance evidence, and deployment support in a structured, detail-focused environment. Role Overview We are looking for an Oracle Fusion Provisioning Analyst with 4-6 years of experience to support user access administration, role configuration, and compliance activities across Oracle Fusion. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys working with access controls, audit readiness, and controlled deployment processes while partnering closely with technical and business stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Manage Oracle Fusion user provisioning, de-provisioning, and access changes in line with approved requests and control requirements. Administer role configuration and access controls to support secure application access. Support Oracle Fusion deployments, configuration updates, and report migrations, including manual deployment activities and GitHub-based coordination where applicable. Assist with SOX, IT General Controls (ITGC), and audit requests by preparing evidence, tracking actions, and supporting remediation. Review quarterly upgrades and validate security configurations and access impacts. Maintain clear documentation for access procedures, compliance controls, and operational handoffs. Partner with internal teams to investigate access issues, resolve provisioning gaps, and keep work moving with minimal disruption. How You Will Do It Own the outcome with accountability, accuracy, and a strong focus on access control and compliance. Stay close to the work by triaging requests quickly, removing blockers, and keeping provisioning responsive to the business. Validate changes carefully, test access and configuration impacts, and document each step so controls remain auditable. Improve every day through candid issue resolution, clean handoffs, and practical problem-solving across deployments and upgrades. Work as one team with security, functional, audit, and business partners to build trust and resolve issues efficiently. Use structured documentation and clear follow-through to support repeatable, controlled operations. Qualifications 4-6 years of experience in Oracle Fusion provisioning, access management, security administration, or a closely related role. Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion role configuration, user access provisioning, and de-provisioning. Working knowledge of SOX controls, IT General Controls (ITGC), and audit support activities. Experience supporting application deployments, configuration updates, or report migrations. Experience with GitHub and manual deployment processes. Ability to work with documentation, evidence tracking, and issue follow-up in a controlled environment. Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and communication skills. Nice to Have Exposure to Oracle Fusion security and compliance-focused analyst work. Experience supporting quarterly upgrades, user acceptance testing, or remediation tracking. Familiarity with compliance documentation and operational reporting. Why Join Us Join Johnson Controls to contribute to secure, reliable Oracle Fusion operations that support critical business processes. You will collaborate with experienced teams, deepen your knowledge of access control and compliance, and help improve how work gets done in a company focused on customer outcomes and continuous improvement. If this sounds like the right next step for you, apply today and help us keep Oracle Fusion access secure and compliant.

title: Data Lead/ Sr. Data Analyst
jobDescription: Senior Data Analyst - Oracle Fusion Johnson Controls creates smart, healthy, and sustainable environments, and our enterprise systems help support that mission every day. In this role, you will work with Oracle Fusion data and reporting to strengthen business insight, improve process visibility, and support reliable operations across the value stream. You will join a collaborative technology environment where data quality, functional understanding, and continuous improvement matter. If you enjoy turning complex business data into clear actions, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact. Role Overview As a Senior Data Analyst - Oracle Fusion, you will support reporting, data analysis, and operational problem-solving across Oracle Fusion ERP processes. You will work closely with business and technical partners to understand requirements, build and maintain reports, analyze issues, and help improve the way data is used to support decision-making and process execution. Key Responsibilities Analyze Oracle Fusion business data and reporting needs across assigned functional areas, with a focus on Procure to Pay processes where applicable. Develop and support BIP and OTBI reports to deliver accurate, timely, and actionable information. Review Oracle Fusion ERP data models, source structures, and report logic to ensure data accuracy and traceability. Support interface and integration analysis using Oracle Fusion REST and SOAP APIs when data flows need to be investigated or improved. Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve data issues, enhance reporting, and improve system performance and reliability. Investigate support tickets, enhancement requests, and data-related incidents; perform root cause analysis and recommend corrective actions. Contribute to backlog prioritization, testing, deployment readiness, and post-go-live support activities. Document analysis, solutions, and reporting logic clearly for technical and business stakeholders. Support continuous improvement by identifying manual steps, data gaps, and opportunities to streamline reporting and operations. How You Will Do It You will own your analysis with accuracy, accountability, and a strong sense of data integrity. You will stay close to the business process, understand the real reporting need, and remove obstacles that slow down users or decision-making. You will use structured problem-solving, candid communication, and root-cause thinking to improve quality every day. You will work as one team with functional, technical, and operational partners to deliver dependable outcomes. You will use Agile ways of working to manage priorities, testing, follow-up actions, and support tasks in a disciplined way. You will document findings, assumptions, and solutions clearly so that reporting logic and data handling remain transparent and maintainable. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 4-6 years of experience in Oracle Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, or a similar enterprise application environment. Hands-on experience with BIP and OTBI reporting. Strong understanding of Oracle Fusion ERP data models and reporting structures. Experience with Oracle Fusion REST and SOAP APIs for data analysis or integration support. Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into reporting or data solutions. Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience supporting Procure to Pay functional flows. Experience with reporting, analytics, or support work in a regulated or data-governed environment. Exposure to Agile delivery, backlog management, or post-go-live support activities. Experience driving process improvements that reduce manual effort and improve data quality. Why Join Us At Johnson Controls, you will be part of a team that values collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous improvement. You will work on meaningful enterprise data and reporting activities that help teams make better decisions and support business performance. If you are ready to bring your Oracle Fusion expertise and analytical mindset to a role with real impact, we encourage you to apply.

title: PTC Functional Senior Analyst
jobDescription: Job Title: PTC Functional Senior Analyst (Oracle Fusion) Location: Bangalore Experience: 8-12 years Job Description: We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Project to Close Functional Senior to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of Oracle Project Portfolio Management Cloud (PPM) modules, with a very good understanding of DevOps methodologies. The role involves leading cross-functional discussions at various levels with business users to analyse requirements, brainstorm, articulate solutions, and recommend industry best practices to stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: Serve as a primary point of contact for business, resolving production support incidents related to Oracle Project Portfolio Management Cloud (PPM). Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and analyze requirements for Oracle Fusion Project Portfolio Management Cloud implementation. Design, configure, and customize Oracle Fusion PPM Cloud applications to meet business needs. Conduct system configurations, testing, and user training as needed. Implementing DevOps practices streamlining application deployment and enhancing system performance. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for effective software delivery. Provide technical support and troubleshooting for Oracle Fusion Project Management Cloud modules. Follow JCI’s Major Incident Management process to address any critical issues (P1/P2) by engaging the right teams. Conduct training sessions for end-users and stakeholders on Oracle Fusion functionalities. Stay updated with the latest Oracle Fusion enhancements and industry trends. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field. Excellent verbal and written communication skills along with strong analytical abilities. Self-motivated with a positive attitude and a can-do approach. Proven ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a reactive high-pressure environment. Strong knowledge of Oracle Fusion Project Portfolio Management and other modules. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to multi-task and handle multiple Fusion instance problems in parallel. 8+ years of experience in consulting or industry, including: 5+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud Fusion modules, including Project Costing, Project Execution, Contract Management. Expertise in Oracle Fusion Project Portfolio Management (PTC) and ERP solutions, with a strong background in functional configurations. Proven track record in PPM, particularly in drop shipment process implementations. Expertise in Oracle Fusion functional configuration and solutions for small- and large-scale initiatives across the globe. Production support experience (at least consecutive 1 year in Cloud applications). Ability to write simple SQL-based reports for troubleshooting without technical team assistance. Basic understanding of cloud integration (FBDI, REST/SOAP APIs) and proven problem-solving methods. Proficiency in Office 365 tools (Teams, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OneNote, Visio, SharePoint). If you are passionate about leveraging technology to drive business success and have a strong background in Oracle Fusion PTC, we would love to hear from you.

title: Oracle Fusion Technical Analyst Senior
jobDescription: Senior Oracle Fusion Technical Analyst Johnson Controls creates smart, healthy, and sustainable environments. title: Application Engineer- Fire & Security
jobDescription: What you will do This position is responsible to design Fire & security systems like Fire Alarm, Access Control, Intruder Alarm, and CCTV per respective account standards. How you will do it Should have strong domain knowledge of Fire & Security System engineering. Should have global customer facing experience. Works independently & is fully proficient in applying established standards/practices. Should act as interface to customers and is responsible to ensure that projects are executed within agreed schedule and budget to meet the customer technical specification requirements. Should be able to independently carry out Hardware Detail Design, Engineering and Application Development, Battery Calculations, Voltage drops calculations etc. Should be able to develop Typical / Templates for Complex systems and develop project specific standards. Should be able to read, Understand Control Narratives, Logic diagrams, Io Matrix etc. Monitors and controls assigned work scope against the project plan, ensures effective change control, and identifies risks / opportunities. Ensures that the proposed engineered solution meets project requirements in terms of functionality, standards, quality, and supporting documentation. Ensure group work in compliance with QMS procedures. Identify possible improvement opportunities and manage their implementation. Ensure common methods, techniques, tools, and products are being effectively applied and provide feedback for future improvement. Ensures that the implementation of application is reviewed with respect to project standards and quality documents. Ensures that the final deliverable meets the functional specifications of the customer by doing the quality checks. Usage of engineering tools for optimization of Engineering man hours to improve productivity & Quality. What we look for Diploma/BE (Electrical/ Electronics). 3-8 years’ experience in Fire & security system design is mandatory. Fire code & security domain knowledge mandatory. NICET/ BS 5839 & Security system product Certifications will be added advantage. Good knowledge of AutoCAD. Good communication skills.

title: Project Manager - Applied
jobDescription: Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. Job Description -Project Manager - Applied (Chillers) Grade: 169/170 Location: Mumbai Reporting To: Senior Project Manager - Applied Projects Experience: 5-8 Years Role Summary The incumbent will be responsible for managing the execution of multiple HVAC and chiller projects simultaneously, ensuring successful delivery in line with customer requirements, contractual commitments, and company objectives. The role will focus on project planning, coordination, schedule management, commercial follow-up, and driving projects through defined toll gates from HOTO to closure. The incumbent will work closely with customers, vendors, site teams, and internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Project Execution & Coordination Manage HVAC/chiller old, ongoing and new projects at different stages of execution. Ensure projects are executed as per approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements. Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, vendors, factories, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution. Track project milestones and drive closure of pending activities. Schedule Management Prepare and maintain project schedules in coordination with customers and internal stakeholders. Obtain customer approval for schedule baselines during HOTO. Monitor progress against planned schedules and initiate corrective actions for delays. Drive timely completion of project milestones and support toll gate movement. Commercial & Financial Management Monitor project costs, committed costs, and revenue realization. Support achievement of forecasted revenue for assigned projects. Ensure timely preparation and submission of invoices as per contractual milestones. Follow up with customers for payment collections and resolution of commercial issues. Maintain Unbilled Revenue (UBR) within prescribed limits. Risk & Issue Management Identify project risks and implementation challenges at an early stage. Maintain project risk and issue logs. Escalate critical risks, delays, and customer concerns to the Senior Project Manager in a timely manner. Work with stakeholders to implement mitigation and recovery plans. Customer Management Act as the primary point of contact for assigned projects. Maintain regular communication with customers regarding project status, schedules, deliveries, and outstanding actions. Address customer concerns promptly and coordinate internal support for resolution. Ensure customer expectations are effectively managed throughout the project lifecycle. Material & Resource Coordination Coordinate with procurement, logistics, factory, and service teams to ensure timely deliveries. Track material availability and installation readiness. Monitor resource deployment requirements at project sites. Reporting & Governance Update project status, forecasts, and financial metrics regularly. Participate in project review meetings and provide accurate project performance updates. Ensure compliance with organizational project management processes and documentation requirements. Support movement of projects through defined stage gates and successful project closure. Desired Skills & Competencies Good understanding of HVAC systems, chillers, and applied projects. Knowledge of project management fundamentals including: Planning and Scheduling Cost Monitoring Risk Management Quality Compliance Customer Management Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Good communication and negotiation skills. Proficiency in MS Project, Excel, ERP, and project tracking tools. Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline. PMP/Project Management certification would be an added advantage. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) On-time achievement of project milestones. Successful movement of projects through toll gates. Revenue realization against forecast. Timely invoicing and collection performance. UBR maintained within target limits. Customer satisfaction. Schedule adherence. Quality and safety compliance. Timely closure of project risks and issues.

title: Field Tech Support Engineer IV
jobDescription: Who we are? About Johnson Controls Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. Visit johnsoncontrols.com for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms. Why JCI: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrbigjbpxkg Asia-Pacific LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feedView=all Career: The Power Behind Your Mission OpenBlue: This is How a Space Comes Alive What you will do? Under minimal supervision provides technical support to the Field Sales & Service organization for Data Center Accounts in a consistent manner across all product offerings. How you will do it? Provide day-to-day technical support for key Data Center Accounts to Field Sales & Service organization on a global basis via site visit, phone, fax, or email. Accountable to create and maintain technical service bulletins, service letters, and updates to the Solutions Database that meets and or exceeds internal and external customer expectations. Processes warranty claims in a timely and consistent manner to facilitate data mining by, product, failed component, defect, and responsibility. Drive product reliability through the Continuous Improvement Process for both existing products and new products being introduced. Product Technical Support Specialist provides technical support and interacts with quality management and engineering to improve overall life cycle cost. The specialist should be able to create test plans to prove out new and or existing product equipment offerings. Maintains effectiveness when experiencing major changes in work responsibilities or environment (e.g., people, processes, structure, or culture); adjusts effectively to change by exploring the benefits, tries new approaches, and collaborates with others to make the change successful. Creates novel solutions with measurable value for existing and potential customers (internal or external); experiments with new ways to solve work problems and seize opportunities that result in unique and differentiated solutions; promotes the involvement co-workers in solving problems that directly impact what people do; leveraging technology to effectively address problems and capitalize on opportunities. Places a high priority on the internal or external customer’s perspective when making decisions and acting; implementing service practices that meet the customers’ and own organization’s needs. Ensures others contribute to organization strategies and driving operational discipline, role clarity and performance transparency by focusing them on the most critical priorities, measures progress, and ensures accountability against those metrics to allow us to act like One Team; sets, documents, and communicates clear work standards to improve performance - “the fundamentals”; making our results widely available and easily accessible. Identifies and understands problems and opportunities by gathering, analyzing, and interpreting quantitative and qualitative information; chooses the best course of action by establishing clear decision criteria, generates and evaluates alternatives, and making timely decisions; taking action that is consistent with available facts and constraints and optimizes probable consequences. Post issue rectification , Engage with the field team and support them with the technical inputs to prepare a 8D report. This is necessary to bring in the confidence with the customer that their equipment issue is been resolved in an organized way What we look for? Up to 15% must be able to travel both domestic and internationally. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related Technical/Scientific field required. Overall 7+ years of experience with minimum of four 4 years’ experience of technical experience with a knowledge of HVAC&R products. Must be able to analyze and solve complex product system problems. Proficiency in Microsoft Suite Applications (Word, Excel, Access, and PowerPoint) as well as Internet software and E-mail is required. Must be proficient in troubleshooting the refrigeration cycle as applied to air-conditioning duty on Applied Equipment. What we offer: We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents Diversity & Inclusion Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.
